notes.title: Behind the Scenes : Cats & Animations
notes.notes: [p]The first step, once the background is ready, is to import it into the animation software Moho.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446166/8f5e396af9b1ac0cf3805d72cf9b209d573d5564.png"][/img][/p][p]Next, I trace the boundaries between elements (since I had the brilliant idea not to put them on separate layers), then assign bones to the moving parts. I animate certain elements frame by frame, like the windmill's propeller.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446166/84065595ae7acc8c3edf5a61ea0d3624d6a2a9f0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446166/a7aae8735b65af94608821aa019f25211690a1df.png"][/img][/p][p]And that’s it! Plenty of cats have taken the opportunity to sneak in while no one was watching![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446166/7c0e556d0160a3dab1d1cb8cad366ced9dde0bf2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Creating a New Level – Behind the Scenes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

For this first devlog, I wanted to show you how I build a level in Seek and Click.

I usually start with a rough sketch to set up the composition and hiding spots. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45446166/db905f48d568135836eb2e64ce30fc48d7b0bcb6.jpg[/img]

Once I’m happy with it, I move on to clean line art.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45446166/4bda4df739704fc0b9ebe47b998277dd14ff481f.jpg[/img]

Then comes the coloring phase, where the atmosphere of the level really starts to take shape.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45446166/eec0bb7eae620d37cab21ebe5072bd0830337b14.jpg[/img]

After that, I animate the elements and let the cats sneak into the background.
And don’t ask where the cats are — they signed a non-disclosure agreement.
